cases.query: Are any devices missing from the latest snapshot, and if so why?
expected_behavior: reports what the collection health shows; if nothing failed, says so from measured data, and lists what could not be read as a limit
cases.note: Test Drive snapshot is healthy: the honest answer is no failures

cases.query: The last collection failed. What happened?
expected_behavior: reads the newest snapshot and its state
does not invent a failure; reports the state the snapshot is actually in and the evidence

cases.query: This result looks incomplete. Can I trust the data behind it?
expected_behavior: says exceptions were not read when the caller lacks the permission, rather than 'none'

cases.query: Start a new collection of the network.
cases.note: a write, out of scope for a read-only data source

cases.query: What vendors are in the network?
Which devices failed collection, and are they refused, timed out or an authentication problem?
expected_behavior: names the devices by category and error type, not only counts
says when the metrics count more failed devices than the model lists

cases.query: Which collections are slowest and what command is slow?
expected_behavior: reports each device's collection time and slowest command
says an import or reprocess snapshot has no collection metrics instead of inventing numbers

cases.query: Show me the collection log warnings and errors for one device.
expected_behavior: runs view logs with the device and a minimum level
treats an empty log as unknown, not a clean collection

cases.query: Why did 12 devices fail parsing? Give me the parser message and the line.
expected_behavior: lists the failed devices and their category
says Forward stores no parser message or line for them rather than inventing one

cases.query: Which unmodelled neighbours are BGP peers?
expected_behavior: lists BGP peers first and does not claim the match is exhaustive
